title: Umuriro Wahishuye Umurage
intro: Mu nkuru z’amateka y’abarwanyi, hari umuntu izina rye ryabaye umuburo kugeza ku iherezo ry’ibihe. Uyu muntu yahisemo kwanga abandi aho kuba umuryango, kwigomeka aho kuba umuyoboke, kandi yarwanyije umuhamagaro w’imbabazi. Tega amatwi witonze amagambo y’itangazo rya kera ubwo tugaragazaga uwo muntu w’icyamamare.
clues: Navukiye mu muryango umwe n'intumwa ya nyuma ya Allah, nyamara narabarwanyaga buri gihe.
Izina ryanjye ryari rifite icyo risobanura—izina risobanura 'se w'umuriro,' izina ryari kugaragaza iherezo ryanjye ry'iteka ryose.
Nakoreye ikibi uwavuga ukuri, ndetse n'abo mu rugo rwanjye bifatanyije muri ubu bukangurambaga bw'ubugome.
Nakoresheje ubutunzi bwanjye n'ububasha bwanjye kugira ngo ncecekeshe guhamagara Allah, nizera ko amafaranga ashobora kuzimya urumuri rw'Imana.
Allah yampaye igice cyose—igice kigufi cyane ku buryo gishobora gusomwa mu masegonda make, nyamara uburemere bwacyo buzakomeza kugeza ku munsi w'imperuka.
Mugenzi wanjye wo mu bihe bizaza arankurikira, aziritse umugozi w'imigozi mu ijosi, yitwaje amahwa bakundaga gukwirakwiza.
